test_cases.title: Agentic AI Standard Workflow Validation
steps: Trigger agentic AI workflow for IT delivery task creation
Monitor AI response for standard input parameters
Validate task creation and attribute assignment
Verify successful AI interaction with backend services
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI correctly processes standard inputs, creates IT delivery tasks with correct attributes, and integrates seamlessly with backend services without errors.

test_cases.title: Agentic AI Invalid Input Handling
steps: Provide agentic AI workflow with invalid or malformed input data
Monitor AI's error detection and handling mechanisms
Check that error messages are clear and informative
Verify no system crashes or unhandled exceptions occur
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI gracefully handles invalid inputs by rejecting them with clear error messages and does not cause system failures or unexpected behavior.

test_cases.title: Agentic AI Edge Case Processing
steps: Submit edge case inputs such as maximum size payloads and boundary values to the AI agent
Observe AI processing time and response correctness
Validate system stability and data integrity during processing
test_cases.expected_result: The AI system accurately processes edge case inputs within acceptable response times, maintaining data integrity and system stability without failures.

test_cases.title: Performance Under Load - Agentic AI Workflow
steps: Simulate concurrent execution of multiple agentic AI invocations (e.g., 100 parallel requests)
Measure response time and throughput
Monitor system resource utilization (CPU, memory)
Verify no drop in accuracy or failures under load
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI maintains performance within SLA thresholds under load, with no failures or degraded accuracy, and system resource usage stays within acceptable limits.

test_cases.title: Security Validation - Agentic AI Access Controls
steps: Attempt to access agentic AI APIs with unauthorized credentials
Attempt injection attacks or malicious payloads via input fields
Check AI system response and logging
Verify adherence to security policies and threat mitigation
test_cases.expected_result: Unauthorized access attempts and malicious inputs are rejected securely; all attempts are logged, and no vulnerabilities are exposed.

test_cases.title: Reliability Test - Continuous AI Operation
steps: Run agentic AI workflow continuously for 48 hours in test environment
Monitor for errors, memory leaks, and crashes
Validate consistent output correctness and system uptime
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI operates reliably without crashes or memory leaks, producing consistent and correct outputs throughout the extended period.

test_cases.title: Scalability Test - Agentic AI Expansion
steps: Increase number of simultaneous AI instances stepwise (e.g., 5 up to 50)
Measure resource consumption and response scaling
Identify any degradation or bottlenecks
Validate AI performance and correctness at scale
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI scales proportionally without performance degradation or functional issues, handling increased load smoothly.

test_cases.title: Agentic AI Integration Failure Simulation
steps: Simulate backend service failures and network disruptions during AI workflow execution
Observe AI ability to detect, handle, and recover from failures
Check error notifications and fallback mechanisms
test_cases.expected_result: Agentic AI detects external failures, gracefully handles errors, alerts relevant systems/teams, and recovers where possible without data loss.

test_cases.title: Environment Drift Detection Verification
steps: Check synchronization status of all deployment environments (dev, test, staging, prod)
Introduce controlled drift in test environment and verify detection
Validate AI's or system's reporting on version drift
test_cases.expected_result: System correctly identifies deployment version drifts and reports them for corrective action, ensuring environments remain in sync.

test_cases.title: Staff Training and Usability Feedback Test
steps: Conduct user training sessions for AI-integrated delivery tools with sample users
Collect feedback on ease of use, clarity, and support materials
Identify gaps causing misunderstandings or inefficiencies
test_cases.expected_result: Users demonstrate sufficient understanding and usability of AI tools; feedback is analyzed to guide training improvements and tool adjustments.

results.failure_analysis: Timeout error: AI processing exceeded acceptable response time for maximum size payload, causing system delay and partial data integrity compromise.
Memory leak detected during continuous AI operation, leading to increased resource consumption and intermittent slowdowns over 48-hour run.
Fallback mechanism failed to recover from simulated backend service disruption; error notifications were delayed and partial data loss occurred.

triaged_defects.root_cause_hint: Potential issues in AI model integration or data pipeline mismatches causing processing errors.
Likely linked to AI algorithm logic or integration bugs identical to TC-0001-03.
Frontend integration or UI framework inconsistencies impacting user interactions.

defect_triage.release_risk_summary: Two high priority defects in the core AI processing cluster require fixing before release to prevent major failures. One medium priority UI defect can be deferred but should be addressed in a subsequent iteration to ensure smooth user experience.

findings.draft_fix: Apply parameterized queries or prepared statements in the database interaction code at src/ai_agent_controller.py line 78 to mitigate SQL injection risk. Validate and sanitize all user inputs before processing.

Replace the current deserialization logic in src/agentic_ai/utils.py at line 145 with a safe deserialization library or explicitly validate serialized input data before deserializing to prevent remote code execution.

Remove hardcoded credentials from config/dev-db-credentials.yml line 12. Use environment variables or a secure secrets management solution instead to avoid accidental secret leakage in the repository.

Change default database passwords in database/config.yaml at line 27 to strong, unique passwords. Implement account lockout mechanisms and limit database user privileges to reduce risk from credential abuse.
Implement proper output encoding and input validation in src/frontend/templates/dashboard.html at line 33 to sanitize user-controllable data and prevent reflected or stored XSS attacks.

quality_gate.gap_explanation: Release blocked due to multiple failing quality gates: pass rate is below 95%, presence of two open high-severity defects requiring fixes before release, two high severity open and exploitable security findings, and incomplete requirement traceability coverage. These issues could cause major functional, stability, and security risks.
